## Usage

Provide `client-id` and `app-private-key` to authenticate with a GitHub App.
The legacy `app-id` input remains supported for existing workflows.

### Basic example

[sync-copilot-instructions.yml](/examples/sync-copilot-instructions.yml)

```{python}
yml_file='../examples/sync-copilot-instructions.yml'
print('```yaml')
with open(yml_file, 'r') as infile:
  print(infile.read())
print('```\n')
```
